scope: Prepared schema v0.3 and all 18 rendered annotation payloads
checked_rules: Task begins with the requested extraction activity and uses ordinary clinical terms.
Inputs contain only instructions, patient ID, supplied letters and schema; no reference answers, scenario or hidden truth.
Unknown dates and unsupported identity remain unknown; proposed care is not enacted care.
The optional prior-history field requires explicit quotes and does not convert unknown onset into complete history.
Tool and prior-conversation use are prohibited; actual trace inspection is separate.
The schema is shared across activities, so timing includes differing output volumes and shared structure.
prior_history_field_reason: Four explicit never-used assertions need a supported scope distinct from an unknown onset; field deletion changes four Q3 answers.
limits: Prompt compliance and clinical entailment require output review; this audit does not assert them.
